summary: 41 units reviewed. Issues: 10 error, 43 minor over 34 units. Main problems: u91 sirā number and Hindi dhamanī as नाड़ी, u115 tābhyām gender and active Hindi for passive, u119 unclear mark mismatched between English and Hindi and 'beginning with' invented, u111 anila/वायु vs वात, u85/u108/u111 Hindi lacks hedges the English carries, u87/u95 Hindi grammar, many unglossed Hindi doctrinal terms. All identifications (sirā, dhamanī, pakvāśaya, sthūlāntra, āmāśaya, lasīkā, kaṇḍarā) look right and properly hedged; no plants. Grouping notes are sensible (90 continues 89; 94 introduces 95; 96-97; 106-107; 98-99; 110-111). Devanagari shows u93 and u112 vowel junctions are hiatus, so the draft's iva and viklinne āhāre are fine. Open items for the owner: u87 vijñānīyāt form, u97 zero-emendation reading, u102 tan-nimitta, u88 atirudhira, u112 neuter subject.
glossary_suggestions: anila in a Kapha-Pitta-anila series = Vāta (English 'the wind (anila, that is Vāta)', Hindi 'अनिल यानी वात'); named vāyus (prāṇa, samāna, vyāna) stay 'wind'/'वायु' with 'a wind' gloss.
Hindi medas = मेद यानी चर्बी, vasā = वसा यानी मांस की चर्बी (kept apart); kiṭṭa = किट्ट यानी अपशिष्ट; prasāda = प्रसाद यानी निर्मल सार; ojas = ओजस् यानी जीवन-सार; mala = मल यानी अपशिष्ट.
A singular accusative/nominative dvandva of two items is a collective (samāhāra) dvandva, neuter.
Adjectives like -vāhinām standing for an unstated srotasām: gram has case and number only.
IAST 'ai' can be a hiatus of two Devanagari vowels (अविभाग इव, विक्लिन्नआहारे): check the Devanagari before arguing about sandhi (confirmed again in ch06 k3 u93).

Conflict between two glossary rules about damaged words: older rule puts 'on a conjectural reading' in translations; p02 ch03 k2 rule keeps the guess out of gloss and translations ('unclear'). Needs one rule (u88, u112, u119).
sirā before a voiced consonant: 'sirā dhamanyaḥ' = sirāḥ (regular sandhi).
Hindi dhamanī = धमनी (never नाड़ी, which is nāḍī); sirā = सिरा यानी शिरा/नस; kaṇḍarā = सम्भवतः बड़े टेंडन; pakvāśaya Hindi = पक्वाशय यानी पचे हुए का स्थान, सम्भवतः बड़ी आँत का क्षेत्र.
